turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi there, how are you feeling today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My car is twelve years old and the repairs keep piling up.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That gets expensive. Are you leaning towards fixing it one more time, or starting to look for a replacement?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hold on, I need to talk to my roommate for a second. Stay quiet until I say I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: What do you think, balloons or streamers?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Because the last time we had balloons the dog popped every single one.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Then streamers and some fairy lights. That looks nicer anyway.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Fairy lights, good idea. Do you still have the ones from your balcony?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Yeah, I can bring them on Friday.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'll be back in five, don't start the movie without me.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Alright. You were weighing up your old car, repair it or replace it?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'll fix it one last time. I can't afford a new one until spring.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sensible. Ask the mechanic what else is likely to go soon, so there are no surprises.
